frequency_question: How often do major energy/infrastructure bills successfully include specific interstate pipeline approval provisions before the deadline?
membership_rule: Members are major federal energy or infrastructure bills enacted into law; excluded are standalone non-energy bills or failed legislative attempts.

cases.name: Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007

coverage_note: 4 major energy/infrastructure legislative packages examined spanning 30 years.
known_gaps: Minor technical corrections bills omitted as they are not comprehensive reform.
skeleton: Decomposed into major energy legislative packages since 1994 that contained explicit infrastructure/permitting provisions meeting the criteria.
validity_reason: Legislative patterns regarding omnibus energy bills remain relatively stable across congressional cycles.
